matchingCriteria.description: Specify the default criteria that is used to find potential predecessor instances.

latestStartTime.description: Specify the latest time when job stream instances can start running. Time restrictions can be specified at different item levels, and follow this resolution order: run cycle (within job stream), job stream, run cycle (within run cycle group), run cycle group.

abstractId.description: The id representing all versions of this object, regardless the validity range.

startCondition.description: Start conditions are used to check for specific conditions before starting the jobs, and to optionally automatically resubmit the job stream to check for next reoccurrences.

workstationId.description: The id of the workstation where this object is defined. In input at least one between workstationId and workstation must be specified.

startDays.description: An offset in days from the specified start time of the job stream.

options.description: Select options for the job stream definition. Draft job streams are excluded from dependency checks and the production plan. Carry forward job streams continue to the next plan if they do not complete before the end of the current production plan.

limit.description: Specify the maximum number of jobs in job stream that can run at the same time.

startTime.description: Specify the start time for job stream instances generated by the run cycle. If "Run as soon as possible" is not selected, job stream instances do not start until this time. Time restrictions can be specified at different item levels, and follow this resolution order: time restrictions defined in a run cycle inside a job stream, time restrictions defined in a job stream, time restrictions defined in a run cycle contained in a run cycle group associated to a job stream, time restrictions defined in a run cycle group associated to a job stream

validTo.description: The "The "Valid to" date for a job stream is a read-only field. It is generated when a subsequent version of the job stream is created (with same folder, name, and workstation values but a later "Valid from" date). In this scenario, the "Valid to" date of the original job stream is set to the instant immediately preceding the "Valid from" date of the subsequent job stream version.

joinConditions.description: Dependencies on sets of predecessors that could be only partially satisfied.

perJobLatestStart.description: Select this option to apply the job stream latest start time to its job instances. Job instances cannot run after their latest start time, and are put in SUPPRESS.

lateStartAction.description: Select the action to be taken when the latest start time elapses. Choose between - Suppress: job instances in SUPPRESS status do not run, and their dependencies are not released. This is the deafult option; Continue: job instances continue running, disregarding the latest start time; Cancel: job instances in CANCEL status do not run, and their dependencies are released.

variableTable.description: Select a variable table. When resolving variables for a job stream instance generated by a run cycle, the system checks the following variable tables in this sequence: the variable table defined at run cycle level, the variable table defined at run cycle group level, the variable table defined at job stream level, the variable table defined at workstation level, the default variable table In input variableTable is ignored when variableTableId is specified.

documentation.description: You can use this space to write comprehensive information about the item, such as its function, expected outcomes, and troubleshooting details. You can toggle "Preview" to see the formatted version of your documentation.

jobs.description: Jobs are the nodes of the steam that are running a task in the workflow.

variableTableId.description: The id of a variable table used by default by the job stream.

saturdayIsFree.description: Enable this option to treat Saturdays as non-working days in addition to any non-working days already specified in a provided calendar.

workstation.description: Specify the path of the workstation where this item is defined. In input at least one between workstationId and workstation must be specified, workstation is ignored when workstationId is specified.

timeZone.description: Select the time zone for the job stream. If no time zone is specified, the job stream uses the time zone set on the workstation where the job stream is defined.

exclusiveRunCycles.description: List of exclusive run cycles, defining exception rules to not schedule the job stream even if selected by a regular run cycle.

priority.description: Specify the priority value that defines the job stream instance submission order.

folderId.description: The id of the folder where a definition is. In input at least one between folderId and folder must be specified.

sundayIsFree.description: Enable this option to treat Sundays as non-working days in addition to any non-working days already specified in a provided calendar.

promptDependencies.description: Prompts that need to be replied before the job stream is launched.

onOverlap.description: How the next instance behaves when the previous instance is still running.

resourceDependencies.description: Resources allocated while the job stream is running.

RunCycle.description: A RunCycle defines the rules to generate (or suppress) scheduled instances of a Job Stream.

latestStartDays.description: An offset in days for the latest start time of the job stream.

deadlineTime.description: Deadline to complete job stream run, as offset from midnight. Only for inclusive run cycles.

description.description: You can use this space to add brief context and information about the item.

validFrom.description: The "Valid from" date defines the earliest moment in time from which this run cycle can schedule instances for its associated job stream in the plan.

type.description: The run cycle type, i.e. how the run cycle specifies the rule to generate job stream instances.

asap.description: True if the job stream has to start as soon as dependencies are resolved, without waiting for start time. Only for inclusive run cycles.

deadlineDays.description: An offset in days for the deadline time.

offsetUnit.description: The day type chosen for the offset.

latestStartTime.description: Latest time the job stream can start, as offset from midnight. Only for inclusive run cycles.

runCycleGroupId.description: For GROUP run cycles, the ID of the run cycle group generating the job stream instances.

startDays.description: An offset in days for the start time.

repeatInterval.description: Specify the frequency (in hours and minutes) with which job stream instances are created, from "Start time" to "Repeat end Time".

startTime.description: The start time of the generated instance, as offset from midnight. If asap is not set to true, the job stream does not start before this time.

validTo.description: The "Valid to" date defines the latest moment in time until which this run cycle can schedule instances for its associated job stream in the plan.

calendar.description: For CALENDAR run cycles, the folder path of the calendar that contains the list of days. In input, calendar is ignored when calendarId is specified.

expression.description: For RRULE run cycles, an iCalendar RRule expression. For CRON run cycles, a UNIX or Quartz cron expression. For SIMPLE run cycles, a comma separated list of dates.

perJobLatestStart.description: If true, the latest start time is checked for each job in the job stream, if false no further check is done after the first job is submitted. Only for inclusive run cycles.

freeDaysRule.description: Specify how to handle instances generated on non-working days.

offset.description: For GROUP and CALENDAR run cycles, the number of days before or after a defined day in the specified run cycle group or calendar.

lateStartAction.description: Action taken when latest start time expires. Only for inclusive run cycles.

repeatEndDays.description: An offset in days for the repeat end time.

variableTable.description: The path of a variable table used by the scheduled instances generated by this run cycle. Only for inclusive run cycles. In input variableTable is ignored when variableTableId is specified.

runCycleGroup.description: For GROUP run cycles, the folder path of the run cycle group generating the job stream instances. In input, calendar is ignored when runCycleGroupId is specified.

variableTableId.description: The id of a variable table used by the scheduled instances generated by this run cycle. Only for inclusive run cycles.

dates.description: For SIMPLE run cycles, a list of dates.

calendarId.description: For CALENDAR run cycles, the ID of the calendar that contains the list of days.

repeatEndTime.description: The time at which the repetition interval stops.
